text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the central 
plaza, I heard voices arguing heatedly.

text_block_list.name: Introverted Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
What's that supposed to mean...? Are you 
making fun of Japanese races?

text_block_list.name: Extroverted Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Not really? I just said it's obviously 
better to be able to succeed overseas too.

text_block_list.name: Introverted Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
It's the same thing...! You're totally 
talking down on domestic racing!

A fight? Just as I thought I ought to step 
in and stop them――

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey! That's enough, you two. Why don't we 
cool off for a second?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I heard pretty much everything. It seemed 
like you started off talking about the 
good points of racing in Japan and abroad, 
but――

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You got a bit too heated, and your 
passions ended up clashing, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Introverted Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: B-But, she was the one who...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's alright. No need to rush.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Listen, both of you. It's true that there 
are plenty of differences between domestic 
and overseas racing.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But your desire to give it your all on the 
track is the same. Is one person's drive 
really superior to another's?

text_block_list.name: Extroverted Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, having trouble putting it into 
words? In that case――

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I have a wonderful idea! ――Music, 
START!!!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Come on! Put the hard-to-say feelings to 
the beat! Express it with your bodies!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Singing or dancing, step by step is fine! 
Clash your feelings together! Come on...!

text_block_list.name: Extroverted Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Clash our... feelings...?

text_block_list.name: Extroverted Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
――Alright! I-I just wanna keep competing 
by your side...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just like that! Ride the rhythm even 
more!

text_block_list.name: Extroverted Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Truth is... Foreign or domestic, I don't 
care at all! With you around, my life is 
drastic and a ball!

text_block_list.name: Introverted Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Same goes for me...! You're my one and 
only rival! Not lonely-one, but truly the 
only-one!

text_block_list.name: Introverted Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
For saying mean things, I am truly sorry! 
Let's keep writing together our legendary 
story!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... wonderful, absolutely wonderful! 
You both spoke your true feelings so well!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Mmm... FRIENDSHIP!!!!

And so, through Seeking the Pearl's unique 
method of resolution, the two students 
reconciled.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that takes care of their problem... 
but what about you?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You look like you've got something to say. 
Come on, express it with your body!

I have no complaints about where I am 
now... but as a Trainer, I want to work 
harder! I want to grow!

Channeling those thoughts into song and 
belting it out, my heart somehow began to 
burn with hot passion...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just like that! More! Unleash it! 
Push to the limit! Now, reach the climax!!

I have no complaints about where I am 
now... but so many things are tiring and 
tough! I want an easier time!

Pouring those feelings into an intense 
dance, my mind felt completely refreshed 
and clear...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's it, let it all out! Don't be 
afraid! It's okay to let go!!

Reflecting on my current situation... I 
have zero complaints! I'm completely 
satisfied with who I am!

Striking a pose packed with that emotion, 
I felt even more content with where I was!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, wonderful! Flawless! Absolutely 
perfect!!
